# FaceAtlas

Namespace `Nfty.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Model`.

```csharp
public static class FaceAtlas
```

The texture every model carries: `[front W][gutter 1][back W]`, height H. The front half is what the front faces (and front-owned wall voxels) show, the back half what the back faces show. The one-pixel gutter repeats the front half's last column. The sampler is `NEAREST`, so there is no smoothing to bleed; the gutter guards the edge texel: a sample exactly on the front half's right edge (u = W / (2W + 1)), or pushed there by float rounding, reads the gutter, never the back half.

## Remarks

A single picture uses the atlas too — its back half repeats the art — so the writers and the preview share ONE texture shape and ONE UV rule (`MeshBuilder`, built from the constants here).

```csharp
public static Image<Rgba32> Build(Image<Rgba32> art, StackFaces? faces = null);
```

Builds the atlas.

**Parameters**

- `art` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - The finished picture; both halves are copies of it when `faces` is null. Not modified.
- `faces` (`StackFaces?`) - The front and back owners' pictures, or null for a single picture.

**Returns.** The atlas; the caller owns it.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentException` - The faces are another size than the art.

### UpdateRegion(Image&lt;Rgba32&gt;, Image&lt;Rgba32&gt;, StackFaces?, Rectangle) { #m-updateregion-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-imag-af6dad }

```csharp
public static void UpdateRegion(Image<Rgba32> atlas, Image<Rgba32> art, StackFaces? faces, Rectangle area);
```

Rewrites a rectangle of an atlas from the art and faces it was built from, in place. The atlas layout lives here and only here: [`FaceAtlas.Build()`](Nfty.Model.FaceAtlas.md#m-build-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-imagesharp-eca903) is this over the whole picture.

**Parameters**

- `atlas` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - An atlas made by [`FaceAtlas.Build()`](Nfty.Model.FaceAtlas.md#m-build-sixlabors-imagesharp-image-sixlabors-imagesharp-eca903) for this art's size; changed in place.
- `art` (`Image<Rgba32>`) - The finished picture; used for both halves when `faces` is null.
- `faces` (`StackFaces?`) - The front and back owners' pictures, or null for a single picture.
- `area` (`Rectangle`) - The art pixels to copy; clipped to the picture.

**Exceptions**

- `ArgumentException` - The atlas or faces are another size than the art.
